tasks.title: AHE step for the planning CT and study series
tasks.test_approach: TDD in tests/test_preprocess.py with synthetic varying volumes (a linear gradient; a landmark only on top of a gradient, never a two-level volume, which skimage returns all 1; generated at test time, SYNTHETIC_ ids as in the existing helpers). The reference equalize in tests calls skimage.exposure.equalize_adapthist directly with kernel default, nbins 128, clip_limit 0.05 on a float32 min-max-scaled array; it never calls the code under test. Read docs/specs/2026-11-04-ahe.md (A1-A8) first. The min-max is `(a - a.min()) / (a.max() - a.min())` on a float32 numpy array in both the code and the reference; compare with np.testing.assert_array_equal. Geometry checks compare the output's (origin, spacing, direction) against the input file read back from disk (both through NIfTI), as the existing FOV tests compare two read-back images.
criteria: PreprocessSteps has an `ahe` field, default False; LEGACY_RNT is unchanged (spec A6)

AHE-only (PreprocessSteps(ahe=True)) on a plan whose varying CT is on a non-default grid (fractional origin, non-unit spacing): the CT output array equals the test's reference equalize of the input CT; it is float32 with minimum exactly 0 and maximum exactly 1; its origin, spacing and direction equal the input CT's (spec AC1a)

SMALL (the test preset: LEGACY_RNT with new_shape (10, 10, 10)) plus ahe: the CT output equals the test's reference pipeline initial resample -> rescale -> reference equalize -> final spacing -> reshape, float32 with all values within [0, 1] (spec AC1b)
The volume is cast to float32 before the min-max; an int16 input CT gives a float32 output (spec A4)
AHE-only: a constant CT becomes all 0, float32, and the plan is preprocessed (spec A4, AC7)

With ahe, a study MR, a study PT and a study CT series are each equalized (their output equals the reference pipeline for their steps); an AHE-only run processes an MR study series instead of refusing it with REASON_NO_SERIES_STEPS (spec AC4)
An AHE-only preprocess() run is accepted, not refused with REASON_NO_STEPS (spec A6)

output_name gains an `image` argument separate from `ct`: `ahe_` sits between `resample_` and `rescale_` for image volumes (CT, MR, PT) and never appears for dose or masks; `rescale_` still needs ct (spec A5, AC5)

STUDY_FILE is `(reshape_)?(resample_)?(ahe_)?(rescale_)?(initialresample_)?(?P<id>series_(CT|MR|PT)_[0-9]+)\.nii\.gz` and series_id reads the id through the named group; series_id returns the series id for `reshape_resample_ahe_initialresample_series_MR_1.nii.gz`, `reshape_resample_ahe_rescale_initialresample_series_CT_2.nii.gz` and the plain name (spec A5)
With `preprocess.equalize_adapthist` monkeypatched to raise, process_ct(ct, PreprocessSteps(ahe=True)) raises CaseRefused(REASON_INTERNAL) (spec Failure handling)
With ahe off, every pre-existing test passes unchanged (spec AC8)
The preprocess module docstring describes the ahe step and no longer says MR or PT series get the geometric steps only (spec A8)

tasks.title: AHE for aligned plan series and the zero fill
tasks.test_approach: TDD with the existing run_plan / mr_spec / rigid helpers, using a varying MR on MR_GRID (np.full constants become all 0 under ahe, so do not reuse them for value checks). Reference: sitk.Resample(reference_equalize(native), final_ct, series_transform(matrix), linear, 0, float32). Geometry checks compare read-back images on both sides, as in t2.
criteria: An aligned MR series on MR_GRID with a translated reg_matrix and ahe on: inside its FOV the output equals Resample(reference equalize(native)) with the series transform; outside its FOV it is 0 (spec AC3)
A non-rescaled aligned CT series with ahe on is filled with 0 outside its FOV, not its own minimum (spec A7, AC3)
The equalized series keeps the native origin, spacing and direction through the numpy round trip: an off-center landmark or the AC3 comparison lands at the same place with ahe on and off (spec A4)
Aligned plan series output names carry `ahe_` at the A5 position for MR, PT and CT series (spec AC5)
Dose and mask outputs (arrays, origin, spacing, direction, pixel ID) are identical between LEGACY_RNT and SMALL (the test preset: LEGACY_RNT with new_shape (10, 10, 10)) plus ahe (spec AC2)
With series_fov_mask also on, the fovmask_ file is written for the ahe series and its values are unchanged by ahe
With `preprocess.equalize_adapthist` monkeypatched to raise, process_series on an ahe run raises CaseRefused(REASON_INTERNAL) (spec Failure handling)
With ahe off, every pre-existing test passes unchanged (spec AC8)

guardrails: At most 5 staged files per commit (commit gate).

No raise inside an except block (guard test).
Private attributes in tests via getattr(module, '_name')  # noqa: B009.
Run the suite with uv run --group dev pytest -q --tb=short; there is no `python` on PATH.
Commit gate: more than 5 staged files fails; findings.md counts. Each task stays at <=4 source files.
